notes.title: Prepare yourself...
notes.notes:
[h1]The long wait is over[/h1]

We started this journey with the dream to publish a game, but not just any game, we wanted to make something different. There were many bumps along the way, and we had to set development aside for a while, but the dream was never forgotten. The flame of REalM kept burning inside of us, waiting to be unleashed, and the time has finally come. To all those who have been waiting all this time, we're sorry it took so long and we thank you infinitely for your patience. To everyone, we hope you can enjoy our game as much as we've enjoyed working on it. Don't be afraid and dive into REalM on October 30!

notes.title: REalM: Walk of Soul / Closed Alpha Invite
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,
we both Authentic Illusions and Games Starter have been working together during the last 9 months to polish REalM to launch it in the best possible state.

Recently we opened a call for for all the fans of the surreal horror adventure genre who want to join and that way help us validate that the game is solid enough to release it commercially. 

If you would like to be part of this closed alpha stage, feel free to answer this questionnaire that will help us to know you better as a player: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc80L0M_FYaVPnK1kvoIO3csyEn1xJEce2BWdt4bwHM37OKDQ/viewform?c=0&w=1]LINK[/url]
